experiment: Compare zero versus 20 critic-only updates before 20 PPO updates on travel endurance. Same seed 11, transferred recovery actor, task, encoders, sample counts per update and selection gates.
warmup_actor_check: The five selection episode records compare exactly before and after warmup; update_critic preserves the actor by implementation and its separate core regression. No complete trajectory was saved by this probe.
ppo_after_warmup: Collector resets to the same seed before PPO. Critic warmup also consumes minibatch-shuffle RNG; post-warmup optimizer order is not held fixed, so this comparison does not isolate critic fitting alone.
conclusion: Neither branch passes. Both final policies crash in all five selection episodes and score below the unchanged source. Do not adopt warmup from this probe or claim endurance improvement.
